title: Part III without the item slide: giant monkey head, catacombs, navigator head and necklace (normal begging), ghost ship (key with the compass, feather, grog, rats, grease, tools, root), cannibals, Bob, to the 'Last Part' card (DOS CD, SCUMM v5)

entry.notes: S5 no-slide exit: routes/anypercent/noslide/S5.json lists every fact below in its exit, and its last goal ends in room 69 (the slide route's S5 also ends here: routes/anypercent/S5-part3-island.json move 80). The necklace's class 6 is not in that list, but it is set from the start (index file DOBJ) and only global 140 [0C0C] clears it (or the debug warp, global/script-001.txt [0F7F]). Ego in room 69 (the idol field at the giant monkey head) or in room 12 (the search then walks through gate 155 first: exit 12 -> 69 needs state 142 == 1). Facts assumed at entry: owner(269) == 1 (the Q-tip key from Herman); has 293 (navigator head) and has 294 (its necklace, picked up with it in global/script-104.txt [04D2]-[04DA], still class 6 so the head's full dialogue runs: global/script-140.txt [0000]-[000C]); has 732 (the magnetic compass: the ONLY way to the ghost-ship key, room-072-gh-captai/local-202.txt [0000]-[0029]. It comes with the ship: Stan's closing pickupObject(732), global/script-056.txt [3EDE]-[3EEE], route S3 move 42, which the no-slide plan keeps (scripts/anypercent_auto.py drops only S3#91-#117). No script takes it away again: the index has no writer of owner 732 other than ego); state 142 == 1 (gate opened by the monkey on the totem nose, persistent: room-012-monkey-he/entry.txt [000E]-[0049]); state 151 == 0 (mouth closed); Bit[364] == 1 (Herman met, else room 12's entry starts his scene, entry.txt [006E]-[0094]); Bit[383] == 0 (no root brewed yet); Bit[426] == 0 (head put away); Bit[357] == 0 (necklace not worn); Bit[470] == 0, Bit[473] == 0, Var[286] == 0, Var[287] == 0 (head never asked); Bit[536] == 0 and Bit[545] == 0; Var[237] == 0 (ghost foot never tickled); Bit[316] == 0 (rats not fed); Bit[51] == 1, Var[19] == 5, Var[196] == 3 (from Part I, needed by S7). Bit[436] == 0 (your ship was not sunk; Part III's vista catapult with Var[242] == 2 would set it, room-011-vista-1/local-207.txt [002C]): with Bit[436] == 0 the crew comes for you at the end (room-070-hellcliff/local-204.txt [0BC1]-[0BE2]), which the last goal's hint assumes. NO SLIDE: inputs are taken only while user input is on (no clicks inside cutscenes); the bridge's automatic '.' and Esc skip lines and overrides. Goals that the script index cannot reach by an object verb handler carry a hint (catacombs, the cabin key, the grog, the grease order, the dialogues).

goals.note: Exit 133 -> 65 needs state 142 == 1 (entry) and state 151 == 1 (goal 1); mouth walk point (813,84). Room 65's entry resets the catacomb counter Var[265] to 0 and, coming from room 12, runs the climb-down cutscene local 202 (no override), which ends with ego in costume 1 at the monkey-head walk point (64,82) and starts the mushroom watcher local 203 while Bit[536] == 0.

goals.name: Take out the navigator head in room 65
goals.note: Writer: Use head 293 -> script 110 (needs costume 1, which local 202 sets at [0058], and Bit[426] == 0). The room-65 pairing keeps the search from taking it out in room 39, where the first take-out also queues doSentence(8,293,0) ('I think it wants me to go to the...', Bit[545], 110 [0147]-[0151]). Do it right after the climb-down, before any walk moves the camera past x=160 (the mushroom cutscene). The head must stay out through the whole maze: local 205 counts an exit only while Bit[426] == 1.

goals.name: Walk to the cave: enter the catacombs (room 39)
goals.note: Cave 755 answers any verb with loadRoom(39) while Bit[383] == 0 (walk point (973,87), about 900 px). On the way the camera passes x=160 and local 203 plays the mushroom cutscene once (Esc ends it via its override, Bit[536] = 1); its walkActorTo(300,120) replaces the cave walk, which must then be issued again. Room 39's entry (head owned) starts locals 207 and 206, which store the target cave in Var[164]; local 204 puts ego at a random entrance. Bit[426] == 1 is part of the target: local 205 counts an exit only while the head is out, and the catacomb hints wait for it, so a branch that reaches room 39 with the head put away is no use.

goals.name: Catacombs exit 1/6: walk to the cave the head points at
goals.cite: room-039-hellmaze/obj-0497-cave.txt [0024]; room-039-hellmaze/local-205.txt [0000]-[0059]; room-039-hellmaze/local-206.txt [0000]-[016D]; room-039-hellmaze/entry.txt [0017]; global/script-109.txt [0000]-[000E]; room-065-hellhall/entry.txt [000B], [0037]-[003F]
goals.note: HINT REQUIRED. The index sees Var[265]++ on all five caves, but the test that picks the right one is '495 == Var[164]', a guard form the search does not parse, and the exit graph offers only two caves per hop. obj_from_var is an existing Move field (src/speedrun/executor.py Move.obj_from_var, accepted by route.to_move): the executor clicks the cave id local 206 stored in Var[164]. The after waits until 206 has chosen a real cave (each room-39 entry resets Var[164] to 0, entry [0017]). Each cave's Walk to starts local 205 after the walk: right cave -> Var[265]++ and a fresh room through script 109; another cave -> Var[265]-- (minimum 0); the entrance cave (Var[266]) -> back to room 65, whose entry resets Var[265] and puts the head away (local 200), so goals 3-5 would be redone. MIDDLE MARKERS: if Var[164] is 543 or 544 (target on the other half) the after never holds; a floor walk across x=320 pans (local 202) and 206 rolls again. Crossing the middle on the way to a cave also pans and cancels the walk: re-issue. The layouts come from the RNG (slide file rng_points; runner sources 3.8). INDEX ARTEFACT: the index also lists Var[265]++ under the guard '!(Bit[426])'. That comes from descumm hiding the jump at local-205 [0018] (bytes 18 1A 00 = goto 0035): with the head put away every cave goes to the wrong-cave branch at [0035], so the head must stay out. The search keeps the 'Bit[426]' branch for each cave because it has fewer missing facts.

goals.name: Put the head away on arrival at the cliff

hint.name: Use the head on the first input frame in room 70

goals.note: The record's head variant (runner sources 3.12 'faster variant'; works without the slide). Without input the entry's local 200 does the same after a cutscene with WaitForActor and delay(60), about 15 frames later. The Use must land by f0+2 so that 111's cutscene freezes the entry before it starts local 200. If input comes later, local 200's cutscene holds input until its own 111 has cleared Bit[426], and the click would take the head out again (110): the hint then misses its until and the search puts the head away again. The hint carries max_frames 6 (an executor Move field that route.to_move accepts, like obj_from_var). Without it the move could pass falsely: play() reads `after` once, then waits for the click gate. If the gate first opens after local 200 and 111 have run, Bit[426] is already 0, so the click's `until` holds at once while the click itself runs 110 and takes the head out again (the head would then be out for the talk and the necklace). With 6 frames, a missed window fails fast and the search's WAIT reaches the goal by local 200's own put-away.

With Bit[426] == 0, 140 calls 110 at its start and 111 at its end; both return at once when ego stands in walk box 8, 9 or 12 (global/script-110.txt [0030]-[0063], global/script-111.txt [0000]-[002D]). goals.note: Writer: ('obj', 294, 9), the Use/Pick up entry @0197 that verbs 7 and 9 share (the index files it under 9). Needs VAR_ROOM 70, Bit[426] == 0 ('I can't put it on now--I've got the head whipped out.') and class 6 clear (goal 16). Required for the ship: script 78 sends ego straight back to room 70 without Bit[357]. 141 plays a 20-frame animation unless actor 12, placed at (x, y+1), lands in another walk box than ego: standing at (46,85) in box 8 skips it. HINT REQUIRED for the verb: verbs 7 and 9 share the entry @0197, but the index files it under 9 only, so the search would click 'Pick up' on the inventory slot. Over the inventory the hover script turns Pick up into Look at (Var[107] 9 -> 8, saved in var 394), so that click only looks at the necklace. 'Use' is not swapped. The slide route uses verb 7 here as well (S6 move 26). The necklace has class 6 only and no preposition class (1-4, global/script-008.txt), so 'Use necklace' runs at once without a second object.

goals.note: Route 75 -> 73 -> 77 -> 70 (cave 855, arrive at (192,111)), then Walk to cave 768 (walk point (2,122)). With the root and Bit[383] == 0 it starts 170 ('A long walk, a brief row, and a short hike later...', override; VAR_ROOM is 0 on that text screen), which loads room 25. Local 200 there starts 106 (the cannibals brew the root, override), which renames 823 'magic seltzer bottle' and sets Bit[383]. HINT added (slide moves 55-58, with the Escs left to the bridge's automatic skips). The search can reach this goal, but the index also credits Bit[383] to 'Talk to head' (293, verb 10): script 140's startScript(200) is resolved to the head's home room 25, whose local 200 starts 106. That false candidate is in the inventory, so the search would try it at every node. The root's class 6 is cleared in the same slice as Bit[383] (106 [0573], then [057D]; the override lands at [0501], before both). S7 needs it: 823's Use handler passes the sentence on only while class 6 is clear (routes/anypercent/noslide/S7.json entry notes), so it is in the target and in the exit.
